description: GPU video enhancement and better search and browsing for Jellyfin. Enhancement: real-time upscaling, denoise, unblur, deblock, deband and more, applied inside the transcode and picked per playback from the player's Enhance panel; your files are never changed. Search and library: tag-aware search with wildcards and exclusions, a Sort & filter sheet, quick and smart tag filters, a date-added filter, infinite scroll, More Like This, bulk tag editing and card badges. Every part falls back to stock Jellyfin if it cannot apply. Options: the Settings button. Full list: ENHANCEMENTS.md at github.com/sanchitd5/jellyfin-plus.
overview: GPU video enhancement plus search, filtering and library improvements.
